incidents.name: RES token pair-balance manipulation
incidents.notes: The RES token's transfer hook rewrites the RES/USDT pair's own RES balance without syncing the reserves, letting the attacker repeatedly swap the imbalance out of the pair for USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: RES 0xecCD8B08Ac3B587B7175D40Fb9C60a20990F8D21 created 2022-07-20T13:06:03Z by 0xf53ff2f90ab93a429b5c6ac0e62825e50ccee195, unrelated to attack sender 0x986b2e2a1cf303536138d8ac762447500fd781c6; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. DeFiHackLabs carries two PoCs (RES_exp and RES_exp2) for this same incident; one row is recorded. lossUsd uses the 290,671 USDT stated in the PoC header and the QuillAudits write-up.
